claim.summary: Single evaluation functional: over every field, for the functional pigeonhole system's reduced-board quotients A_k (modulo the domain, V_k; modulo the closure, V_k/W_k with W_k the span of the x_s Q_i' with |s|+1 <= k) and L >= K >= 0: if evaluation at a set X of partial matchings at which every element of W_{K+L} vanishes is injective on A_K, the sum lambda of the evaluations at dim A_K of those points with bijective evaluation leaves no nonzero u in A_K with lambda(u v) = 0 for all v in A_L (lambda(uv) = (Mu)^T(Mv), M invertible). Instances: modulo the domain with X the partial matchings of size <= K, on every board; modulo the closure with X the total matchings, where they embed A_K, computed over F_2 at K = 2 on the reduced boards with 3 and 4 pigeons and 8 holes. So a variable error with 1+K+L <= D <= ceil(N/2) and L >= K has native count 1 in those cases, by lem:native-restriction.
claim.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with corrections, checked in one follow-up; its general form and instance (ii) follow the reviewer's suggestion, instance (ii) computed over F_2 only.

claim.summary: Native restriction: over any field, for the functional pigeonhole system (Booleanity, hole and functionality axioms, pigeon axioms Q_i = 1 - sum_h x_ih, multilinear ring) with any number of pigeons and N holes, D <= ceil(N/2), C its degree-D closure and H that of the hole and functionality axioms, an edge e and K, L >= 0 with 1+K+L <= D: (a) 1 is not in C; (b) the least number of old functionals modulo H whose rectangle forms mu(x_e u v), v in V_L, detect Ann_H(x_e) cap V_K is the least number of functionals on V_{K+L}(B_e) detecting 0 in V_K(B_e) through V_L(B_e), B_e the board without e's pigeon and hole; (c) modulo C it is the same count on A_k = V_k(B_e)/W_k(B_e), W_k the span of the x_s Q_i' with |s|+1 <= k (Q_i' the reduced pigeon axioms; counted before restriction, so that N = 1 is covered), by lem:functional-killer-transfer at K and K+L; (d) hence ceil(dim A_K / dim A_L) <= m_min(C) <= dim A_K (the injectivity through the reduced board's closure for N >= 2, directly at N = 1), and likewise for H with V_k(B_e); (e) in the H-model at K = 2, L = 1 with p pigeons and n holes on B_e the lower bound is 1 + ceil((p-1)(n-1)/2).

claim.summary: Over any field, for a down-set X of {0,1}^N the associated graded algebra of the functions on X under the degree filtration is the face ring of X modulo the squares, with socle spanned by the facets; so it has a perfect graded pairing, the hypothesis of prop:frobenius-marked-separation, exactly when X has one facet (a standard computation). Product domains with one-hot coordinates are such down-sets, of socle dimension prod max(|A_j|-1,1), Gorenstein exactly when every |A_j|<=2; the hole-respecting assignments of the product pigeonhole system with m>=2 pigeons have no such pairing. Graded annihilation bounds domain killers from below: fE=0 on X gives lead(f)lead(E)=0 in the graded algebra, while a graded annihilator need not lift (x_[N] on the cube); on the cube both least degrees for monomial errors are the transversal number.
claim.assessment: Working proof of a standard computation, passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with a follow-up; the leading-form direction and the non-lifting example are its corrections.

claim.summary: Native rectangle upper bound: over a field k, J_{D'} the degree-D' part of the Boolean ideal in n variables, errors E_1..E_s of degree <= e, each supported on a nonempty subcube A_i of the cube of dimension a_i (over F_2, any nonempty affine subspace with affine coordinates, as Pang's E_i = P g_i with linear inputs), U = V_K and slack L with e+K+L <= D': the sum_i N_{a_i}(max(K-L,0)) <= s N_n(max(K-L,0)) old functionals lambda_{i,y} = sum over z in y + B_L of E_i(phi_i z)^{-1} delta_{phi_i z} (B_L the points of weight <= L in coordinates phi_i of A_i, y of weight <= max(K-L,0)) detect the stacked kernel in rectangle forms mu_j(E_i u v), v in V_L. Proof: a translated ball is independent for degree L (unitriangular evaluation), its rectangle forms recover the values of u on it, the balls cover B_K, and B_K determines degree-K functions (lem:all-field-approximate-majority-certifier-barrier). For s = 1, N_a(K)/N_a(L) <= m_min <= N_a(max(K-L,0)), the ratio tending to binom(K,L) for fixed K >= L; L = 0 and K <= L give equality.
claim.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with corrections (max(K-L,0), the any-field subcube form, fixed t in the comparison).
